summary: The Queen Anne's County Library (QACL) urges the FCC to keep the E‑Rate program unchanged, opposing any new restrictions that would tie library funding to screen‑time limits or require monitoring of patrons. It argues that such controls are impractical, infringe on privacy, and could block legitimate educational resources.
